gt_provenance.details: Derived analytical quantity (cosine of probe weight vectors). No external GT. Design is appropriate for a geometric claim.

score_normalization.details: Cosine similarity normalized by vector norms (standard). Random-direction null provides valid theoretical comparison (1/sqrt(D) ~ 0.016).

result_existence.details: All files exist and numbers match: cos_bootstrap.json (mean=0.015, CI=[0.001, 0.034]), cos_trajectory.json (neighborhood mean=0.025), nulls.json (random null=0.011, shuffled=0.016), single_pass.json (|cos|=0.139). All within thresholds.

dead_code.details: _cos() function called in layer sweep and bootstrap; outputs in all artifact files.

scope.details: 33 layers, 200 bootstrap resamples, neighborhood L*+-2. Single-pass variant reported alongside. No scope over-claim.
